response.name: Relics 0.10.7.4
response.changelog:
* Partially prevented Shadow Glaive from targeting immortal entities. When attempting to attack an invulnerable entity, the glaive will simply switch to another target
* Extended target navigation for Shadow Glaive, Holy Locket and Spore Sack (and some items from addons). Projectiles now prioritize targeting monsters and players first, then neutral mobs, and only after that any other entities
* Improved Phantom Boot movement prediction. This practically eliminates cases of flying off the bridge at high speeds
* Made Phantom Boot bridge less bouncy
* Added ability to descend on Phantom Boot bridge by crouching

response.name: Relics 0.10.4
response.changelog: * Relic generation logic has been tweaked (once again). This should increase the chances of obtaining relics unique to specific dungeons/biomes from the corresponding chests, compared to other relics that have less stringent generation rules.

response.name: Relics 0.10.3.2
response.changelog: * Fixed an issue where relic researching was impossible when another player was nearby

response.name: Relics 0.10.3.1
response.changelog:
* Fixed issues with the relic research progress bar:
  * Added interpolation for displaying the progress bar at more than 20 FPS.
  * Research progress now resets when moving the cursor to a different slot.
  * Opening the research UI now requires 20 ticks instead of 10.
  * The key for researching an item can now be configured in the control settings.
* Fixed the targeting of Shadow Glaive and Spore Sack projectiles on armor stands.
* Fixed the damage resistance formula for the first ability of Holy Locket; the item no longer grants immortality as it previously did.

response.name: Relics 0.10.3

* Slightly adjusted the balance of Shadow Glaive
* Fixed the "flawless" status of relics with non-upgradable abilities
* Ability stats ending in .0 are now rounded (1.0 -> 1)
* The maximize/minimize commands now automatically adjust the research status of abilities

response.name: Relics 0.10.2
response.changelog:
* Relic loot system has been completely overhauled. Instead of being strictly tied to structures, the generation now focuses primarily on biomes, making relic discovery slightly more intuitive.
* Shadow Glaive has been reworked. It is now an equippable item and provides a greater impact in combat.

response.name: Relics 0.10.1
response.changelog:
* The mechanics of the Infinite Ham have been significantly reworked: two old abilities have been updated, a new ability has been added, the item design has been revamped, and a tooltip frame has been introduced.

response.name: Relics 0.10
response.changelog:
- Added a new information block in the relic description – experience sources, detailing the methods of gaining experience for each individual relic. Currently, this feature is available only for two relics from Relics, but we have already implemented it for all items in RAR-Compat and will release an update soon.
- The relic research interface has been divided into tabs instead of separate interfaces.
- Added additional obfuscation for the descriptions of abilities that have not yet been researched.
- The formula for calculating relic quality no longer takes into account abilities that have not yet been unlocked.
- Increased the speed of opening the relic research GUI.
